The test image shows a soybean leaf with small, scattered reddish-brown spots on the upper surface. The spots are small, irregularly shaped, and distributed across the leaf with no obvious yellow halos or gray centers.

Key features: leaf, small dark brown spots, scattered pattern, upper surface view.

Top candidates: Septoria_brown_spot (small irregular dark brown lesions), Soybean_rust (small tan-brown spots, pustules on lower surface), Frogeye_leaf_spot (gray centers with reddish borders).

Let me view one reference image for Septoria_brown_spot.

The Septoria reference shows more advanced, coalesced lesions with yellowing. The test image shows earlier-stage disease with small, scattered reddish-brown spots on a still-green leaf. This matches Septoria brown spot's early presentation (small dark brown irregular lesions before coalescence).

The spots don't show gray centers (ruling out Frogeye), no angular vein-limited pattern (ruling out Bacterial Blight), and no visible pustules on this surface (though Soybean rust remains possible). The small, dark, scattered brown spots on a leaf upper surface best fit Septoria_brown_spot.
